text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document states a total approved budget of $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states that, following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The difference between the $2,600,000 adjusted figure and the $2,400,000 approved figure is $200,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"},{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown describes the December 2026 revision as made by the Finance Committee, but the documents don't state whether the Finance Committee formally approved the change before implementation.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1]}],"missing":["The documents don't state that the Finance Committee formally approved the budget change before implementation."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
